logdir.description: Directory for log, pid, and temporary files.

docroot.description: Document root directory for serving web content.

erl_lib_dir.description: Base directory for Yaws Erlang libraries (ebin).

port.description: Primary HTTP port to listen on.

listen.description: IP address to bind the server to (empty or '*' = all interfaces).

user.description: System user account to run the Yaws process as (empty = current user).

group.description: System group to run the Yaws process as (empty = current group).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP connections.

recv_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for receiving HTTP request headers/body.

send_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for sending HTTP response body.

directory_listing.description: Enable or disable automatic directory listing.

server_alias.description: Server identification string (appears in Server header).

ssl_vhosts.description: List of HTTPS virtual hosts with SSL configuration.

name.description: Virtual host name (used as config block ID).

listen.description: IP to bind to for this vhost.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format).

ssl_cacert_file.description: Optional path to CA certificate chain file.

docroot.description: Override docroot for this vhost (defaults to global docroot).

plain_vhosts.description: List of plain HTTP virtual hosts.

name.description: Virtual host name (used as config block ID).

port.description: HTTP port for this vhost (defaults to global port).

listen.description: IP to bind to for this vhost (defaults to global listen).

docroot.description: Override docroot for this vhost (defaults to global docroot).

directory_listing.description: Override directory listing for this vhost (defaults to global setting).

erlang_flags.description: Erlang VM flags passed at startup (e.g., '-smp enable -pa /path').

extra_app_dirs.description: Additional directories containing Erlang .beam applications (added to code path).
